# SaltWatch Card 0.6.3 beta 2

This beta incorporates reviewed Danish terminology while retaining the paired-metric divider alignment fix from beta 1.

## What changed

- Changed the Danish low-marker label from `Lavgrænse` to `Minimumsmærke`.
- Applied the same term to the marker's accessibility description and graphical-editor controls.
- Kept threshold terminology unchanged where the text describes the numeric boundary rather than the visual marker.

## Validation

- 56 unit tests passed, including explicit assertions for all affected Danish strings and the accessible marker label.
- 47 browser tests passed across desktop and mobile Chromium; one desktop-only mobile-scroll test was skipped as intended.
- The longer `Minimumsmærke` label was verified inside narrow, fixed-height translated cards without clipping or overflow.
- The production TypeScript and Vite build passed.
